verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents issuing CUSTOM virtual cards (VCN) for uses you define, with 'one card per supplier' given as the example. Each card has its own limit, can be cancelled, and the marketing site promotes cards specific to software spend. This delivers per-vendor card isolation with separate ceilings. However, nothing shows that a card can be locked to a single merchant, and the 'controls' are not described, so complete coverage of the story isn't established. missing for 10: documented merchant/MCC locking that enforces a card works only at one vendor, explicit detail on what VCN controls cover, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can create single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS subscriptions and procurement so one compromised vendor never exposes shared credit

citations.quote: CUSTOM a use you define, e.g. one card per supplier
Issue, look up, top up, reveal and cancel virtual cards (VCN) for travel bookings (hotel and air) and uses you define.
For CUSTOM, Update VCN tops up the ceiling, extends or shortens the window and adjusts the controls, without replacing the card.
